body:
## Pull request overview This PR completes a French localization refresh across `docs/fr-FR/`, aiming to align the French docs with the current English sources while preserving code/config examples and site formatting. **Changes:** - Updated French preset pages and the French presets index to translate headings, descriptions, and download link text. - Refreshed French installation/guide content (notably package-manager tables and some platform-specific sections). - Overhauled large portions of `docs/fr-FR/config/README.md` and `docs/fr-FR/advanced-config/README.md` with updated translations and additional sections (e.g., Maven, VCS). ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 16 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.
